relevance_note: Case report of a compound heterozygous LCAT patient with family carrier testing: "We describe the first clinically and genetically confirmed case of FLD in Colombia".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in scratch only assembled the JSON and checked spans/fields. No tables with patients (Table 1 is primers). In scope: the proband ('patient'), her parents (carrier testing), her three brothers (all tested; two carry Arg268His and have low HDL-C; the third brother's result is not stated, so he has no variant row), and three previously published people with individual-level detail: ref 14 (homozygous Arg123Pro Spanish woman), ref 20 (Blanco-Vaca, homozygous Arg123Cys, FED) and ref 21 (Bérard, compound heterozygous). Brothers 1 and 2 are the two carriers; which of the 'three brothers' they are is not identifiable, labels are arbitrary order. Low HDL-C in the two carrier brothers comes from the named-group sentence 'the two siblings of the proband are carriers ... HDL-C levels that are persistently below normal'. Relatives' zygosity/pathogenicity left not reported (paper says only 'carriers'). Brothers' gene symbol span is the carrier-analysis sentence. Contradictions/ambiguities: (1) Bérard case (ref 21) is said to have 'the same mutation as the Spanish patient' (Arg123Cys of ref 20) but also 'harboring one of our patient’s mutations' (our patient has Arg123Pro); variant left 'not reported'. (2) 'The patient’s plasma LCAT concentrations and alpha LCAT enzymatic activity were significantly reduced' is ambiguous (Bérard case vs proband; the authors state they could not measure LCAT activity), so not recorded for anyone. (3) 'LCAT enzymatic activity was 15.2 nmol/mL/hour ... in a homozygous patient.20' is placed in an Arg123Pro context but cites ref 20 (Arg123Cys); not recorded. (4) Proband's esterified cholesterol 6% of total cholesterol is reported in the case, but the Discussion says 'we were unable to calculate this ratio' (CE/TC); recorded as observed from the case text. (5) LDL-C described as 'continuously low' but also 'low but among the reference levels (0–150 mg/dL)'; recorded observed. (6) Anemia: episodes in 2018 and 2019 (observed) but no anemia at the time of consultation (excluded row with that qualifier); checklist anemia = observed (had it). (7) Abstract calls the variants 'heterozygous', Introduction/Discussion 'compound heterozygous'; zygosity recorded compound heterozygous. Normal labs recorded per D-27 as excluded abnormalities (liver/renal function tests, creatinine, vitamin D, ferritin, phosphorus, total cholesterol). Ref 14 corneal dystrophy and capillary wall thickening not mapped to checklist corneal opacity / GBM thickening; 'segmental hyaline lesions' not mapped to glomerular sclerosis. First author surname taken as 'Ciro Acosta' from the header order (surname-first); uncertain. n_patients_reported = 1 from 'the first ... case'.
